'''Sergei Gukov''' ({{langx|ru|Серге́й Гу́ков}}; born 1977) is a professor of [[mathematics]] and [[theoretical physics]]. 
==Education==
Gukov graduated from [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]] (MIPT) in [[Moscow, Russia]] before obtaining a doctorate in physics from [[Princeton University]] under the supervision of [[Edward Witten]].<ref>Interview at MIPT (in Russian)：https://vk.com/@dgapmipt-pk2020-sergei-gukov</ref>
==Career==
===Academic posts===
He held a Long-term Prize fellowship of [[Clay Mathematics Institute]] at [[Harvard University]] (2001–2006) and during 2007-2008 was a member of the school of mathematics at the [[Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton]]. 

Since 2007, he has been professor of mathematics and theoretical physics at the [[California Institute of Technology]] (Caltech). Starting 2010, Gukov was elected as an external scientific member of the [[Max Planck Society]] at the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics|MPIM]], Bonn.

In 2022 Gukov was appointed as a Senior Professor in the School of Theoretical Physics at [[Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies]]. There he has organised a number of important conferences including [https://www.dias.ie/2022/11/08/prof-sergei-gukov-hosts-conference-exploring-relationship-between-computer-science-and-mathematics/ Computer science for knotty math problems] and was lead organiser for [https://www.dias.ie/2023/05/08/two-oldest-institutes-for-advanced-studies-in-the-world-come-together-for-dublin-event/ ‘The Amplituhedron at 10] the first joint conference between the two oldest Institutes for Advanced Studies in the world [[Institute for Advanced Study]] and DIAS.
===Committees and boards===
Sergei Gukov is a member of the Scientific Board of the [[American Institute of Mathematics]] (AIM) and a member of the International Advisory Board of the Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Scientific Research Board {{!}} American Inst. of Mathematics|url=https://aimath.org/about/scientificboard/|access-date=2024-02-14|language=en-US|website=aimath.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Advisory board|url=https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/qm/international-advisory-board|website=sdu|access-date=2025-11-30|language=en}}</ref> He has served on numerous other scientific committees and advisory boards. He is editor of the journal Communications in Mathematical Physics,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Communications in Mathematical Physics |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/220/editors |access-date=2024-02-14 |website=SpringerLink |language=en}}</ref> Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications|url=https://www.worldscientific.com/worldscinet/jktr|website=World Scientific Publishing|access-date=2025-11-30|language=en}}</ref> and Letters in Mathematical Physics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Letters in Mathematical Physics |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/11005/editors |access-date=2024-02-14 |website=SpringerLink |language=en}}</ref>
===Lectures===
In 2010, along with [[Alain Connes]], Gukov was invited to deliver the 8th [[Teiji Takagi|Takagi]] Lectures, the only named lecture series of the [[Mathematical Society of Japan]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=TAKAGI LECTURES |url=https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~toshi/jjm/JJM_HP/contents/jjm-takagi.htm |access-date=2024-02-14 |website=www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp}}</ref> In 2019, Gukov was invited to give the Whittemore Lectures at Yale University.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Whittemore Lectures {{!}} Department of Mathematics |url=https://math.yale.edu/seminars/whittemore-lectures |access-date=2024-02-14 |website=math.yale.edu |language=en}}</ref>
===Research===
Known for Gukov-Vafa-Witten superpotential, Gukov-Witten surface operators, and Gukov-Pei-Putrov-Vafa (GPPV) invariants. In recent years, he teamed up with [[Boris Feigin]], [[Hiraku Nakajima]] and other mathematicians to explore hidden algebraic structures in topology and in quantum field theory.<ref>{{Citation |title=Sergei Gukov: Hidden algebraic structrures in topology | date=3 September 2019 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NUyTymRmEJI |access-date=2024-02-14 |language=en}}</ref>
